summary: Completed portfolio API and responsive browser regression testing. Contact persistence/validation, navigation, filters, project detail, placeholders, required fields, mobile menu, and mobile overflow passed.
critical_code_review_comments: Contact submission has no explicit backend rate limiting or spam protection; consider this before production launch.
seed_data_creation: One TEST_-prefixed contact submission was created through the public contact endpoint; no production records were modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Core home/work/detail/contact flows passed on mobile. Reduced-motion check was inconclusive because the smoke canvas is only rendered on the home route; verify it on home if needed.
rca of the issue: No reproducible application defects found. The reduced-motion attempt queried the home-only canvas while still on /work, so that assertion was a test limitation rather than an app failure.
